title: Proofs of Two Positivity Conjectures of Guo
summary: We prove two positivity conjectures proposed by Guo for alternating sums and factorial ratios built from Gaussian coefficients. The first result proves the positivity of the odd $q$-super Catalan numbers \[ C_{m,n}(q)=\frac{[2m+1]![2n]!}{[m+n+1]![m]![n]!}. \] The proof uses the positivity theorem of Warnaar and Zudilin for the usual $q$-super Catalan numbers, together with two recurrences obtained from a double application of the $q$-Chu--Vandermonde summation.
